title: 光・電子デバイス工学
subtitle: Opto Electronic Devices
educationalGoal: Student will learn Large Scale Integrated Circuits (LSI), Optical Devices, and also Sensing Devices, that are the basic technology supporting today’s information and telecommunication systems. Student will learn CMOS structure, Logic LSI, Memory LSI, Discrete devices including compound semiconductor, as an electronic device and Light Emitting Diode (LED), Laser Diode (LD), Photo Detectors, Imaging devices, as an optical device.
advice: The basic structure and operation principal and also recent topic on the main optical and electronic devices used today. It is one of the basic technology supporting today's information and telecommunication system, Following are planed; 1. Large Scale Integrated Circuits (LSI) 3. Sensing Devices 1.1 CMOS Structure and Characteristics 1.2 LSI 4. Optical Devices 1.2.1 Scaling rule and progress of LSI 4.1 Optical property of semiconductor 1.2.2 Logic LSI 4.2 Light Emitting Diode (LED) 1.2.3 Memory LSI 4.3 Laser Diode (LD) 1.3 Process Technology of LSI 4.4 Solar Cell 1.4 Design Technology of LSI 4.5 Optoelectronics 2. High Speed Devices for telecommunication
books: We have not prepared English textbook.
requiredKnowledge: Class is for students having acquisition of “Electronic Engineering”, “Physical Engineering”, and “Semiconductor Engineering”. Using those knowledge, students will learn today's main optical and electronic devices.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain CMOS Structure and Characteristics
Be able to explain type and structure on Logic LSI and Memory LSI
Be able to explain outline of process technology and design technology of LSI
Be able to explain high speed telecommunication devices and sensing devices.
Be able to explain structure and feature of LED and LD
Be able to explain outline of solar cell and optoelectronics
